title: Universal Import Adapter Framework
start_authority: Owner Continue freshly verified exact canonical AIOC/application heads, confirmed no competing MAI-06 branch/PR, re-read completed MAI-01..05 evidence, and resolved provider-specific adapter seams using current official Tiled/LDtk/Foundry format evidence before implementation.
objective: Implement a deterministic provider-neutral import-adapter registry and bounded proof adapters that translate source-specific structured map/scene data into completed MAI-02..05 presentation contracts while preserving source/checksum/license/provenance/unsupported metadata and never mutating canonical owner-domain state.

selection.explicit_adapter_id: If supplied, it must resolve exactly to a registered adapter and no detector may override it.
selection.automatic_detection: When no adapter is pinned, run deterministic detectors in stable adapter-id order and require exactly one strong match.
selection.ambiguous_or_no_match: Return explicit ambiguous-adapter or unsupported-source outcomes; do not guess.

adapter_registry.extensible_rule: Future adapters register against the same provider-neutral interface and cannot change canonical MAI contracts.

provider_evidence.tiled: Tiled stable JSON map format exposes map type/version/tiledversion, orientation, layers, tilesets, grid dimensions and object geometry.
provider_evidence.ldtk: LDtk JSON schema exposes jsonVersion, levels, worlds/definitions/layers/tilesets/entities/custom fields.
provider_evidence.foundry: Foundry Scenes support JSON import/export and Scene data includes structured background/grid/document fields; provider version differences remain adapter-local.

mapping.target: Completed MAI-02 asset/package/provenance, MAI-03 projection, MAI-04 visual connectivity and MAI-05 descriptive geometry contracts only.
mapping.rule: Only explicitly mapped semantics enter canonical presentation fields; source-specific semantics remain adapter-local or preserved as unsupported metadata.

resolved_contract.partial_packages: Missing optional/unsupported provider data produces deterministic diagnostics and explicit partial/unresolved outcomes; no missing asset, semantic meaning, permission or owner state is invented.
resolved_contract.receipt: Stable normalized adapter id/version + source checksum + deterministic mapping/diagnostic summary produces a platform-identical MAI-06 import receipt.
resolved_contract.owner_rule: Adapters may emit normalized presentation descriptors and stable owner references only; MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration remain sole owner truth.

acceptance_profile.provider_neutral: No Tiled, LDtk, Foundry or future provider schema becomes canonical Multiversal truth.
acceptance_profile.selection_determinism: Pinned selection is exact; unpinned detection is stable and rejects ambiguity.
acceptance_profile.preservation: License/provenance/checksum/import lineage and raw unsupported source data survive normalization without permission inference.
acceptance_profile.bounded_mapping: Proof adapters cover representative structured fields and explicitly diagnose everything not mapped.
acceptance_profile.partial_behavior: Unsupported/partial packages remain explicit and do not invoke MAI-07 substitution or silent invention.
acceptance_profile.owner_boundaries: Import performs no World/Scene/Visibility/Combat/D29 mutation or adjudication.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused MAI-06 verifier/client regression plus MAI-05/04/03/02/01 predecessor and owner-boundary regressions, exact-head Repository Health, self-hosted Linux/Windows and deterministic comparison before merge.

nonauthorization: migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: Implement only bounded MAI-06 adapter registry/contracts/proof adapters and focused evidence on integration/mai-06-universal-import-adapter-framework; validate exact head, merge only after required gates pass, then close MAI-06 completed_verified and select MAI-07 without starting it.
